summary: The current utf8_decode implementation has two boundary-check defects matching both failing groups: its Unicode maximum comparison permits values above U+10FFFF, and its surrogate check detects only the upper half of U+D800–U+DFFF. The decoder contract and affected assertions are included in the supplied evidence, enough to identify a concrete source repair.
hypotheses: The out-of-range check uses an incorrect upper bound, allowing some decoded values above U+10FFFF to report no error.
The surrogate check matches only code points whose upper bits equal 0x37, leaving the lower half of the surrogate range unreported as invalid.
